caption.en: An opalescent white glass egret perched quietly on a waterside stone—windswept crystal plumes, dark translucent beak, and olive-glass legs casting sunlit caustics.
caption.zh: 靜立水畔石上的乳白琉璃白鷺，微風吹拂的水晶冠羽、深色半透明長喙，與橄欖綠琉璃細足在石面折出淡淡光影。

alt.en: Opalescent white translucent glass egret sculpture with windswept glass head plumes standing on a stone by sunlit water
alt.zh: 站立於水邊石上的乳白色半透明琉璃白鷺雕塑，具飄逸玻璃冠羽與深色長喙
